integrity.dual_degree_basis: Oeding Theorem 5.3 gives the binary dual Chow degree, and Lee--Sturmfels equation (2) restates it for multiple-root loci.
integrity.first_public_date_basis: The arXiv record for math/0311312 is dated 2003-11-18.
integrity.primal_degree_basis: Lee--Sturmfels equation (1) states Hilbert's degree formula explicitly; Feher--Nemethi--Rimanyi use the same classical degree formula as a starting point.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: The full archival paper lists AMS Subject classification 14N10, 57R45.
integrity.proof_basis: Legendre's factorial valuation formula converts the multinomial symmetry factor into a base-p carry count; the dual bridge follows by comparing Oeding's formula with Hilbert's formula after shifting every part down by one.

scientific_limitations: The arithmetic theorem is extracted from known closed formulas for primal and dual degrees; it does not determine equations or singularities.
The dual statement is restricted to partitions with no part equal to one, exactly the classical dual-hypersurface case.
A purely arithmetic source may contain equivalent carry formulas without multiple-root-locus terminology.
title: Prime-carry laws for primal and dual degrees of binary multiple-root loci
